arxiv-2208-00993.description: Abstract Tensor factorization has received increasing interest due to its intrinsic ability to capture latent factors in multi-dimensional data with many applications such as recommender systems and Electronic Health Records (EHR) mining. PARAFAC2 and its variants have been proposed to address irregular tensors where one of the tensor modes is not aligned, e.g.

arxiv-2303-12004.title: Comparison of Polarized Radiative Transfer Codes used by the EHT Collaboration
arxiv-2303-12004.creator: Ben S. Prather, Jason Dexter, Monika Moscibrodzka, Hung-Yi Pu, Thomas Bronzwaer, Jordy Davelaar, Ziri Younsi, Charles F. Gammie, Roman Gold, George N. Wong, Kazunori Akiyama, Antxon Alberdi, Walter Alef, Juan Carlos Algaba, Richard Anantua, Keiichi Asada, Rebecca Azulay, Uwe Bach, Anne-Kathrin Baczk
arxiv-2303-12004.description: Abstract Interpretation of resolved polarized images of black holes by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) requires predictions of the polarized emission observable by an Earth-based instrument for a particular model of the black hole accretion system. Such predictions are generated by general relativistic radiative transfer (GRRT) codes, which integrate the equations of polarized radiative transfer in curved spacetime.

arxiv-2304-02752.title: Dense Clusters in Hypergraphs
arxiv-2304-02752.creator: Yuly Billig
arxiv-2304-02752.description: Abstract . In this paper we solve the problem of finding in a given weighted hypergraph a subhypergraph with a maximum possible density. We introduce the notion of a support matrix and prove that the density of an optimal subhypergraph is equal to ‖ A T ​ A ‖ \|A^{T}A\| for an optimal support matrix A A .

arxiv-2307-13645.title: Learning Transferable Object-Centric Diffeomorphic Transformations for Data Augmentation in Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2307-13645.creator: Nilesh Kumar, Prashnna K. Gyawali, Sandesh Ghimire, Linwei Wang
arxiv-2307-13645.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nilesh Kumar, Prashnna K. Gyawali, Sandesh Ghimire, Linwei Wang. Obtaining labelled data in medical image segmentation is challenging due to the need for pixel-level annotations by experts. Recent works have shown that augmenting the object of interest with deformable transformations can help mitigate this challenge. However, these transformations have been learned globally for the image, limiting their transferability across datasets or applicability in problems where image alignment is difficult.

arxiv-2308-04813.title: CLEVA: Chinese Language Models EVAluation Platform
arxiv-2308-04813.creator: Yanyang Li, Jianqiao Zhao, Duo Zheng, Zi-Yuan Hu, Zhi Chen, Xiaohui Su, Yongfeng Huang, Shijia Huang, Dahua Lin, Michael R. Lyu, Liwei Wang
arxiv-2308-04813.description: Abstract With the continuous emergence of Chinese Large Language Models (LLMs), how to evaluate a model’s capabilities has become an increasingly significant issue. The absence of a comprehensive Chinese benchmark that thoroughly assesses a model’s performance, the unstandardized and incomparable prompting procedure, and the prevalent risk of contamination pose major challenges in the current evaluation of Chinese LLMs.

arxiv-2405-04705.title: Stability and dynamics of the laminar flow past rectangular prisms
arxiv-2405-04705.creator: Alessandro Chiarini 1 and Edouard Boujo 2
arxiv-2405-04705.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alessandro Chiarini 1 and Edouard Boujo 2. The laminar flow past rectangular prisms is studied in the space of length-to-height ratio ( 1 ≤ L / H ≤ 5 1\leq L/H\leq 5 ), width-to-height ratio ( 1.2 ≤ W / H ≤ 5 1.2\leq W/H\leq 5 ) and Reynolds number ( R ​ e ⪅ 700 Re\lessapprox 700 ); L L and W W are the streamwise and cross-flow dimensions of the prisms. The primary bifurcation is investigated with linear stability analysis.

arxiv-2410-18786.title: Applying Neural Monte Carlo Tree Search to Unsignalized Multi-intersection Scheduling for Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2410-18786.creator: Yucheng Shi, Wenlong Wang, Xiaowen Tao, Ivana Dusparic, Vinny Cahill
arxiv-2410-18786.description: Abstract Dynamic scheduling of access to shared resources by autonomous systems is a challenging problem, characterized as being NP-hard. The complexity of this task leads to a combinatorial explosion of possibilities in highly dynamic systems where arriving requests must be continuously scheduled subject to strong safety and time constraints.

arxiv-2504-04929.title: The Linearized Vlasov–Maxwell System as a Hamiltonian System ( Second Revision, Clean Version )
arxiv-2504-04929.creator: Dominik Bell, Martin Campos Pinto, Stefan Possanner, Eric Sonnendrücker
arxiv-2504-04929.description: Abstract We present a Hamiltonian formulation for the linearized Vlasov–Maxwell system with a Maxwellian background distribution function. We discuss the geometric properties of the model at the continuous level, and how to discretize the model in the GEMPIC framework [ 17 ] . This method allows us to preserve the structure of the system at the semi-discrete level.

arxiv-2505-19809.title: Representation Learning for Equivariant Inference with Guarantees
arxiv-2505-19809.creator: Daniel Ordoñez-Apraez, Vladimir R. Kostić, Alek Fröhlich, Vivien Brandt, Karim Lounici, Massimiliano Pontil
arxiv-2505-19809.description: Abstract In many real-world applications of regression, conditional probability estimation, and uncertainty quantification, exploiting symmetries rooted in physics or geometry can dramatically improve generalization and sample efficiency. While geometric deep learning has made empirical advances by incorporating symmetry and geometry priors, less attention has been given to statistical learning guarantees.

arxiv-2510-23640.title: Structure-Aware Fusion with Progressive Injection for Multimodal Molecular Representation Learning
arxiv-2510-23640.creator: Zihao Jing, Yan Sun, Yan Yi Li, Sugitha Janarthanan, Alana Deng, Pingzhao Hu
arxiv-2510-23640.description: Abstract Multimodal molecular models often suffer from 3D conformer unreliability and modality collapse, limiting their robustness and generalization. We propose MuMo , a structured mu ltimodal fusion framework that addresses these challenges in mo lecular representation through two key strategies.

britannica-1911-martens-frederic-frommho.description: Article 'Martens, Frédéric Frommhold de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Russian jurist, was born at Pernau in Livonia. In 1868 he entered the Russian ministry of foreign affairs, was admitted in 1871 as a Dozent in international law in the university of St Petersburg, and in 1871 became lecturer and then (1872) professor of public law in the Imperial School of Law and the Imperial Alexander Lyceum.

pmc-10477157.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitors combined with or without radio(chemo)therapy for locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-10477157.creator: Xiao-Han Zhao, Hong-Mei Gao, Jing-Yuan Wen, He-Song Wang, Luan-Ying Wu, Chun-Yang Song, Wen-Zhao Deng, Shu-Chai Zhu, Wen-Bin Shen
pmc-10477157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveThis study was designed to investigate the efficacy and prognostic factors for immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) combined with or without radio(chemo)therapy and to evaluate their toxicity in patients with locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (LA/RM ESCC).MethodsIn this study, 198 patients with locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic (LA/RM) ESCC who received ICIs combined with or without radiotherapy/chemotherapy in the Department of Radiotherapy of the Fourth Hospital of Hebei Medical University were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-10562866.title: Health care system and patient-related factors affecting low cancer screening participation in Poland
pmc-10562866.creator: A Andrzejczak, M Rucińska, E Żarłok, K Osowiecka
pmc-10562866.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Highlights•Low level of participation in cancer screening in Poland.•More activity by general practitioners to increase cancer screening participation.•Better promotion of screening by central institutions.•Recommended sending personal invitations.Keywords: Cancer, Breast cancer screening, Cervical cancer screening, Health care system-related reasons, Patient-related reasons Introduction Screening tests for cancer are targeted at people without visible symptoms to detect the disease at an early stage with a higher probability of cure.

pmc-10673151.title: A Rare Case of Isolated Hepatocellular Carcinoma Metastasis in Left Mandibular Region in a Patient with Hepatitis C Virus Liver Cirrhosis Diagnosed after the Onset of COVID-19 Infection
pmc-10673151.creator: Dragan Mašulović, Aleksa Igić, Aleksandar Filipović, Miloš Zakošek, Dušan Bulatović, Ksenija Mijović, Marjan Micev, Danijel Galun, Evangelos Cholongitas, Nikolaos Machairas, Dimitrios Karagiannakis
pmc-10673151.description: Background and Objectives: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) most frequently metastasizes in the lungs, abdominal lymph nodes and adrenal glands. Metastatic spread to the head and neck area is extremely rare. In the presented case, an uncommon site of solitary metastatic spread of HCC to the mandible confirmed after the core biopsy of the lesion is reported.

pmc-11080293.title: Study on the mechanism of peanut resistance to Fusarium oxysporum infection induced by Bacillus thuringiensis TG5
pmc-11080293.creator: Hongbo Du, Chuanrong Li
pmc-11080293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Peanut root rot, commonly referred to as rat tail or root rot, is caused by a range of Fusarium species. A strain of bacteria (named TG5) was isolated from crop rhizosphere soil in Mount Taishan, Shandong Province, China, through whole genome sequencing that TG5 was identified as Bacillus thuringiensis, which can specifically produce chloramphenicol, bacitracin, clarithromycin, lichen VK21A1 and bacitracin, with good biological control potential.

pmc-11347172.title: Monitoring nucleolar-nucleoplasmic protein shuttling in living cells by high-content microscopy and automated image analysis
pmc-11347172.creator: Marina Engbrecht, David Grundei, Asisa M Dilger, Hannah Wiedemann, Ann-Kristin Aust, Sarah Baumgärtner, Stefan Helfrich, Felix Kergl-Räpple, Alexander Bürkle, Aswin Mangerich
pmc-11347172.description: The nucleolus has core functions in ribosome biosynthesis, but also acts as a regulatory hub in a plethora of non-canonical processes, including cellular stress. Upon DNA damage, several DNA repair factors shuttle between the nucleolus and the nucleoplasm. Yet, the molecular mechanisms underlying such spatio-temporal protein dynamics remain to be deciphered.

pmc-11624165.title: Thiophanate-methyl and its major metabolite carbendazim weaken rhizobacteria-mediated defense responses in cucumbers against Fusarium wilt
pmc-11624165.creator: Kai Cui, Xiaoming Xia, Youwei Wang, Yueli Zhang, Ying Zhang, Junli Cao, Jun Xu, Fengshou Dong, Xingang Liu, Xinglu Pan, Yongquan Zheng, Xiaohu Wu
pmc-11624165.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The effect of fungicides on the plant-rhizosphere microbiome is a subject of ongoing debate, but whether any alteration in the rhizosphere microbiome could affect plant health is an issue that has not been thoroughly investigated. To address this deficiency, we analyzed the rhizosphere microbiome of wilt disease—resistant and disease-susceptible cucumber cultivars to determine whether (and which) plant-associated microorganisms have a role in disease resistance.

pmc-12824191.title: A framework for real-time image detection of bioaerosols
pmc-12824191.creator: Ryne A. Juidici, Yan Ye, Francisco J. Romay, Miles Owen, Qisheng Ou, David Y. H. Pui
pmc-12824191.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Starting from the elastic light scattering and the induced fluorescence emission from airborne particles and extending to the counting and differentiation of the associated signals, a framework is proposed to describe the detection of bioaerosols using an image sensor. For validation, monodisperse NaCl particles were generated to mimic abiotic particles, while monodisperse 1% mass riboflavin particles were generated to mimic biotic particles.

pmc-13477132.title: What's in a name? Gender and ethnic bias in letters of recommendation by large language models
pmc-13477132.creator: Stephanie Johnson, Simran Rai, Yazan Saleh, Abigail Greek, Gal Levy, Bobby Yanagawa
pmc-13477132.description: ry residency is highly competitive, offering few spots to many qualified applicants. Letters of recommendation (LORs) play a pivotal role in the application process. Gender-based stereotypes have been shown in human-written LORs, which often emphasize communal attributes for women versus agentic achievements for men. Large language models (LLMs) are used to generate LORs today.

pmc-13592538.title: Congenital Nephrotic Syndrome in Oman: A 20-year single-centre experience
pmc-13592538.creator: Muzna Al Hashmi, Anisa Al Maskari, Sulaiman Al Saidi, Badria Al Ghaithi, Mohammed Al Riyami, Naifain Al Kalbani
pmc-13592538.description: SummaryObjectives:Congenital nephrotic syndrome (CNS) is a rare, severe disease presenting within the first three months of life, with limited prevalence data from Oman and the Gulf region. This study aimed to report 20 years’ experience of congenital nephrotic syndrome (CNS) in a single centre in Oman.
